  Staff review the order and inspect its data.
}

  Checkout("Checkout") <<Core>>:::critical
  Payment("Process payment")
  Review[Review order]
end

  "items": [{ "name": "Book", "quantity": 1 }],
  "total": 29.95
}:::data

Customer starts@-- "places order" ---> Checkout
Customer --> Browse
Checkout pays@..> : include Payment
Staff --> Review
Review --> OrderData
